text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and E because they were above my average cost may reflect taking profits too quickly; I should base decisions on future prospects and portfolio risk, not each position’s purchase price.","My account value fell despite several profitable sales, so realized gains alone do not show whether my overall strategy is working; I should assess total returns and diversification.","Price history does not predict future changes. I should avoid frequent reactions to short-term moves and make deliberate decisions using current information and a consistent plan."]}
